lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is Monday night in Telluride, where Town Council votes on the 2027 budget and property tax levy — and takes a second crack at an ordinance that would suspend the Open Space Fund's cut of Real Estate Transfer Tax revenue for the year, a real tension worth watching. Ouray City Council is doing the same kind of heavy lifting with its own 2027 budget, mill levy, and fee schedule, while the Telluride Fire Protection District weighs financing options and a second budget reading. Sandwiched in there, the Norwood Planning and Zoning Commission digs into Land Use Code and Master Plan updates — the kind of foundational work that shapes what gets built in that valley for years to come.
